//: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT OR Apache-2.0 — Postern CLOUD (control plane) data-residency options. NOT LEGAL ADVICE. Mirrors enterprise/comms/compliance/residency.config.json for the managed control plane. Residency choice has legal consequences (adequacy, transfer mechanisms) that require legal review — this file only declares the DEPLOYMENT options honestly. See docs/specs/POSTERN-ENTERPRISE.md §9.
appliesTo: managed control plane + managed nodes it provisions (tenant metadata, node lifecycle records, ops metrics, audit)

options.label: European Union
options.crossBorderTransfer: None by default. Any transfer of personal data outside the EEA requires an Art. 44-49 mechanism (adequacy decision / SCCs) — legal review required.
options.notes: Recommended default for EU-established tenants / EU-employed data subjects.

options.label: Brazil
options.crossBorderTransfer: International transfer governed by LGPD Arts. 33-36 (adequacy, SCCs, specific consent) — legal review required.
options.notes: Recommended for BR-established tenants / BR-employed data subjects. ANPD is the supervisory authority.

options.label: Self-hosted / on-premises (customer-controlled)
options.regulation: Determined by the customer's own jurisdiction & deployment
options.crossBorderTransfer: Entirely under the customer's control; the customer is the controller and its own operator, and sets residency.
options.notes: Postern Labs operates no control plane in this mode and is NOT a processor. The customer holds all stores. Strongest residency guarantee and the more-private path; self-hosting stays free.

rails: Residency is a DEPLOYMENT config, not a legal opinion. Choosing 'eu' does not by itself make a deployment GDPR-compliant.
When Postern Labs runs the managed plane it is a DATA PROCESSOR (tenant = controller); a DPA is required (LGPD Arts. 39-40 / GDPR Art. 28). See COMPLIANCE.md and spec §9.
Hosted is LESS private than self-hosting; residency affects WHERE tenant metadata and node records physically live, not who operates the plane.
Cross-border transfer of personal data is a legally gated act — the transfer mechanism must be reviewed by counsel before enabling.
